findings.summary: The merge doesn't verify that customer_id is unique in segments, so duplicate segment rows duplicate orders, inflate revenue, and can place revenue in multiple segments.

judge.reason: Describes duplicate segment rows per customer duplicating orders and inflating revenue across segments, which is the same join-fanout defect.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Using how="inner" silently drops orders whose customer has no segment row, so segment totals don't add up to total revenue and nothing flags the gap.

judge.reason: Matches the known inner-join-drops-unmatched-orders problem, not the duplication bug.

findings.label: valid_other
